title: Wilkins 975XL repair kits, sizes, and model identification
description: Identify a Zurn Wilkins 975XL or 975XL2, select its size band, and open the official repair-kit family without creating a separate page for every pipe size.
summary: Match the complete 975XL or 975XL2 label and nominal size. This reviewed map covers 3/4–2 inches; the current parts breakdown separates standard, complete, rubber, and seat kits.
statusNote: The smaller 1/4–1/2 inch legacy family is outside this reviewed kit map. Do not substitute 975XL3 references or infer compatibility from a retailer title.
diagramAlt: Reduced pressure backflow assembly showing two check covers and the relief valve zone
identifiers: The model marking may read 975XL or 975XL2; do not substitute 975XL3 data.
Two check covers sit above the reduced-pressure zone and relief assembly.
RK34 and RK114 denote different size bands. A complete XLC kit and a separate seat SK kit are different service scopes.
